title: Kelly Johnson's A-2 Design – handwritten Lockheed calculation sheet with aircraft sketch
description: Reproduction of a handwritten Lockheed Aircraft Corp. (California Division) engineering sheet titled "Kelly Johnson's A-2 Design," dated September 1958. It includes a rough planform sketch of the aircraft with notes such as "Use 10,000# airplane at 135,000'" and "Try to eliminate fuselage except for cockpit & equip. bay," an L/D estimate of 6.0 to 5.5, and an itemized weight breakdown (wing, tail, engines, gear, payload, fuel system) with a range calculation. Chapter 6, page 265.
